Take it out quick before it can heal itself!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 7 (Formerly, [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Ghoul''' is an enemy that appears only in [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode. It also appeared in [[The Takeover Event]]. It has a decently high health and a slightly slow speed. On all waves, it appears as a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy, which means towers must have hidden detection to be able to target it. The only time it spawns without it is if the [[Patient Zero]] summons it. On certain waves, it can also have other attributes, like [[Bloated]] and [[Slime (Attribute)|Slime]], making it quite dangerous. Due to a bug, '''Ghouls''' with the [[Slime (Attribute)|Slime]] attribute do not spawn the [[Slime]] upon death. ==Appearance== The '''Ghoul''' is a tall humanoid with a waist, lower arms and lower legs in its rig. It has a light green skin color, torn dark grey shorts, a belt and a ragged white lab coat. It has exposed green veins, multiple tumors on its body and a malnourished chest. It has green glowing eyes and black patches of hair on its head, with a few strands on the sides. ==Strategy== *Towers with hidden detection and a good amount of DPS like the [[Assassin]], [[Cowboy]], [[Militant]], [[Crook Boss]] or [[Golden Crook Boss]] can be effective against it. **Later on, high DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]], [[Crook Boss]] or [[Hunter]] can kill these with ease. *Towers with high damage can be quite useful against it, such towers include the [[Military Base]] and [[Trapper]]. *Splash damage towers like the [[Rocketeer]] can prove effective in clearing out '''Ghouls''' in later waves due to its hidden detection and high splash DPS, considering they appear in large groups. **While other splash damage towers such as the [[Mortar]] and [[Demoman]] cannot target '''Ghouls''' directly, they can still be hit by their splash radius if another detectable non-hidden enemy is nearby. *Stalling towers like the [[Freezer]] and the [[Warden]] can be utilized to slow the '''Ghoul''' down. **Other stallers such as the [[Sledger]] and the [[Tesla]], despite not being able to detect the '''Ghoul''', can still indirectly hit the '''Ghoul''' if a enemy nearby is detectable. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Ghoul.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker2Ghoul.png|Overclock variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseGhoul.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} NEWGAMEMODETHUMBNAIL.png|'''Ghoul''' on the game thumbnail.
